study_note: D256-1 (Half-scale 1:1 baseline) in the base-v2 single-seed exploratory Humanoid Walk inner-loop update-schedule study. It uses J=8, N=256 rollouts per round, H=3, batch size 256, and shared G=1 joint updates per round, for 2,048 total imagined rollouts, 6,144 imagined transitions, 8 critic, 8 actor, and 8 automatic-temperature updates across 8 joint update slots per real action. Replay capacity is 6,144, matching the per-action model-step budget. All non-inner-schedule algorithm settings, training-focused evaluation gates, 14-million-decision budget, seed 55, and no-model-checkpoint policy are inherited unchanged from base-v2. This remains a single-seed exploratory variant and supports no confidence, significance, or confirmatory claim.
